# identifier scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:identifierScheme`](gmeow-identifierScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/identifierScheme>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

The scheme of an identifier — e.g. 'lei', 'ror', 'naics', 'isicV4', 'companyRegistration', 'wikidata'. Declared on the [`Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) node, not the [`Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md), to avoid cross-product pairing bugs when multiple identifiers coexist.
